<details open>

mtmd : fix YuE2 projector loading (#32606)

- Allow cls.output.weight to be absent from the mmproj. It is an optional
Qwen3 reranking head that the YuE2 NAR decoder never uses.

- Without this fix, mtmd_init_from_file() fails with
"tensor cls.output.weight is missing from the mmproj", preventing
audio generation from starting.

</details>

**Website:**
- <https://llama.app>

**Attestations:**
- <https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/attestations/69877272>

**macOS/iOS:**
- [macOS Apple Silicon (arm64)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/b12553/llama-b12553-bin-macos-arm64.tar.gz)
- macOS Apple Silicon (arm64, KleidiAI enabled) [DISABLED](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/23780)
- [macOS Intel (x64)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/b12553/llama-b12553-bin-macos-x64.tar.gz)
- [iOS XCFramework](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/b12553/llama-b12553-xcframework.zip)

**Linux:**
- [Ubuntu x64 (CPU)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/b12553/llama-b12553-bin-ubuntu-x64.tar.gz)
- [Ubuntu arm64 (CPU)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/b12553/llama-b12553-bin
